video.title: How I Make $35k/Month With Other People's Content (Legally)

summary: Chris Koerner shows how he makes $10k-$35k/month profit on Facebook's creator program by adding commentary to viral content (claimed fair use), spending about 3 hours a week. He walks through sourcing reels on a fresh Instagram account, scripting with Gemini, editing green-screen overlays in CapCut, posting natively everywhere, and tagging creators. He funnels Facebook traffic to a Beehiiv newsletter (96k to 250k subscribers in a year) and monetizes signups via SparkLoop. A sample video critiques a junk removal claim and lays out a no-truck bootstrap plan.

ideas.name: Facebook creator monetization with value-added commentary on viral content
ideas.one_liner: Find proven viral reels/tweets in your niche, add commentary (fair use), post natively on Facebook and get paid by Meta's creator program.
ideas.business_model: Platform ad-revenue share (Facebook creator monetization) plus newsletter funnel
ideas.problem: Facebook lacks enough creators posting content for its daily users
ideas.offer: Green-screen commentary videos, screenshot posts, photos, carousels or text posts adding insight to viral content

pricing.notes: Business/finance niches pay more than gaming/unboxing

acquisition_channels.details: Post natively (never cross-post) on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat Spotlight, X, Threads, LinkedIn; source ideas from a fresh Instagram research account and X bookmarks

quote.text: upload it natively to every single platform because I promise you, I've tested this, other people have tested this. You will get a lot more views
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.delivery: Chris sources viral content (~3 hours/week), records a phone video with a DJI mic or uses a Gemini-written script on a teleprompter, edits green-screen overlay in CapCut, or pays an editor ~$10 per video; tags original creator
unit_economics_claims: Videos taking 5-10 min + $10 editing earned $500-$2,000 each
ideas.time_to_first_revenue: Took a long time for first dollar; need Facebook invite to monetization (no published thresholds)

acquisition.how: Sourcing viral posts and scheduling across platforms can be agent-run; virality is inbound.

onboarding.how: No customer onboarding; monetization requires Facebook invite.

delivery.how: AI (Gemini) can script and edit; face-to-camera recording and genuine commentary needed for fair use and reach; fully AI reposting risks strikes.

uk_applicability.notes: Facebook monetization is available in the UK (eligibility varies by country); UK copyright has narrower 'fair dealing' (criticism/review, quotation) than US fair use, so commentary must be substantial and attributed.

risks: Copyright strikes if commentary is not transformative; UK fair dealing narrower than US fair use
Platform dependency: Facebook can change payouts or ban accounts
Monetization is invite-only with no published criteria
Needs a niche and consistent posting; new accounts get a few hundred views

acquisition_channels.details: Post on personal Facebook to find first 2-3 customers

tactics.name: Viral-content commentary workflow
steps: Create a fresh Instagram research account (up to 4 sub-accounts) and train it on your niche
Check reel views by tapping the like count; prefer already-viral (500k+) videos
Bookmark ideas to bank for creative moods
Record commentary with a hook and a retention hack; or have Gemini watch the video and write a 60-second script for a teleprompter
Edit in CapCut: cut dead space, overlay, remove background, mute original, add captions and images
Tag the original creator
Upload natively to every short-form platform

quote.text: Every video needs a retention hack. There needs to be a reason for the person to stay until the end.
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Never cross-post
steps: Turn off the 'also post to Facebook/Instagram' toggle
Upload natively on each platform for more reach

quote.text: Never, ever, ever cross-ost.
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Screenshot viral tweets in your niche for Facebook photo posts
steps: Search X/bookmarks in your niche for already-viral posts
Pick ones fitting one screenshot
Stay in your niche so the algorithm matches
Add a hard-stance take in the caption

quote.text: I'm looking for content that would be easily screenshottable and preferably something that is already viral
